strings.name: Charoen Sirivadhanabhakdi
strings.summary: Charoen Sirivadhanabhakdi is a Thai entrepreneur who founded TCC and developed beverage and property businesses. He participated in cross-border corporate expansion in Southeast Asia and remains ThaiBev chairman after leaving several other chairmanships in 2025.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026; recent roles are supported by ThaiBev's board roster and a September 24 report. Board chair, Group CEO and honorary titles are distinct; partial succession does not mean complete retirement.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed Thai beverage and property groups and participated in Southeast Asian food, retail and cross-border acquisitions.
strings.facts.f1.label: Educational honors
strings.facts.f1.value: The doctorates listed by Asset World are honorary awards, not evidence of doctorates earned through coursework.
strings.facts.f2.label: Management and governance
strings.facts.f2.value: Charoen chairs ThaiBev while Thapana is Group CEO; these are separate roles.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Regional corporate expansion
strings.highlights.h1.text: Beverages provided a base for cross-border investment; the shareholders in the 2013 F&N transaction were TCC Assets and ThaiBev, not simply Charoen personally.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Board succession
strings.highlights.h2.text: F&N, Frasers Property and Asset World each changed chair in 2025; retained honorary titles do not mean continued service in the former board positions.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Re-elected to ThaiBev's board
strings.timeline.t1.text: The AGM approved his re-election, and he remained chairman.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Leaves Asset World chairmanship
strings.timeline.t2.text: He resigned as director and chairman; the current website lists him as honorary chairman.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Frasers Property succession
strings.timeline.t3.text: He retired as chairman and director and became chairman emeritus; Chumpol NaLamlieng succeeded him as chairman.
strings.timeline.t4.title: F&N succession
strings.timeline.t4.text: After the AGM he retired as chairman and director and became chairman emeritus, with Koh Poh Tiong succeeding him.
strings.timeline.t5.title: F&N offer closes
strings.timeline.t5.text: TCC Assets and ThaiBev together held 90.3% at that point; this was their combined corporate stake at the transaction date.
strings.timeline.t6.title: ThaiBev lists in Singapore
strings.timeline.t6.text: The company listed on the Singapore Exchange, not the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
strings.timeline.t7.title: ThaiBev holding company established
strings.timeline.t7.text: Related beverage companies were brought into a holding-company structure.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Chang beer launched
strings.timeline.t8.text: The Chang brand entered the market, marking an important stage in the beverage business.
